item.title: New Team Xray X4F Front Balancing Weights
item.description: Team Xray has released new X4F front left and front right 45g brass weights that are moved from the bumper to under the front driveshafts in the center of the front drive train for improved weight transfer on & off power.

item.title: New RC Discharger Storage Case
item.description: RC Discharger designed a case to address travel storage needs, offering a professional solution for transporting our 2S and 4S discharging systems.

item.title: New JConcepts 2026 Apparel Line
item.description: JConcepts reloads for the 2026 season with new apparel to go with a fresh and rejuvenated racing team.

item.title: New Klinik RC 10 Year Anniversary Apparel
item.description: Klinik RC has released their new 10 year anniversary apparel for 2026.

item.title: New Hobbywing Team Edition G4R Spec Motors
item.description: Hobbywing would like to introduce the new G4R Team Edition Spec Motors.

item.title: New Upgrade RC 1.9" Crawler Tire Options
item.description: UpGrade RC is announcing a trio of new 1.9” high performance tires for the most popular RC crawling platforms.

item.title: New ProTek RC 8000mah 1S Battery and Fan Options
item.description: ProTek RC is proud to announce the release of its new stock spec 1S 150C 8000mAh LiPo shorty battery pack created for 1/12 pan car racing. ProTek RC also is unveiling two new high-speed cooling fans to its product lineup.

item.title: New Team GFRP HBS High Bite Sprint Car
